rooms.name: The Immortal Map Room of the Orc Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand upon a cloud in the sky, overlooking an intricate maze of passages
below, even though in fact they reside below the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For the first time during your journey beneath the surface, you actually
feel a sense of peace and security. If you wish, you can remain here to rest
your weary bones or you could venture back into the network of tunnels to the
south. It may also be possible to work your way through the dirt roof and
back onto the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Small is right! You have no sooner walked into the tunnel than you are at
its end. The only choice you have is to return the way you came.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You walk further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of dirt.
Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has not been
completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work your way
through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface. The tunnel
to the south will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As expected, you now stand face to face with a wall of dirt. It appears
as if this area of the tunnel as been set aside as some type of animal shelter,
a number of kennel-like holes dug into the tunnel walls either side of you.
The bones of small forest creatures lie scattered about on the floor and
tufts of fur have been placed down to fashion what looks like a mat.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For once you can see relatively well further ahead of you and unfortunately
it doesn't look like there's a lot there. The tunnel extends to the west and
north, both directions ending in a dirt wall. There is also the option to
return east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
It is becoming remarkably cooler the further north you travel within the
burrows. You cannot see it but can quite clearly hear the dripping of water
from the east and wonder what its source is. The tunnel also extends to the
west and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The sound of dripping water grows louder and is most probably coming from
the east. There is also a small recess in the northern wall which you could
enter or you may travel back to the west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You discover the source of the water is in fact numerous tree roots which
crowd the southern exit from the tunnel. It streams down the roots and forms
pools of water on the ground, changing the usually dry dirt into mud. You
could push your way south through the roots or return to the west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The temperature within the burrows is actually starting to cool down but
you are unsure as to why. The layer of dirt covering every part of your
exposed body is now a thin film of mud thanks to the heat you've already
experienced. You may travel to the east or south from here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A T-junction in the tunnel system allows you to travel to the north, west
or south. Any thoughts of leaving a trail should have been carried out by
now as you find yourself deep within the maze beneath the surface. Looking
down, you see a series of footprints, the majority of which lead to the north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Crawling around on your hands and knees is becoming tiresome, especially
since you are now filthy! You make a silent promise that next time you'll
let others do the adventuring for you. You may crawl to the south or east of
here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A light breeze cools you down slightly and you wonder why you had not
noticed any air flow previously. The only entrance for air into this place
was through the way you came in and it certainly couldn't progress this far
without an exit point. You are uncertain as to which direction the breeze
came from but you can try and find it by crawling to the west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice is the smell, then you see the cause. Off to
the side of the tunnel is the rotting carcass of what must have been a deer.
You are almost overwhelmed by the stench but notice that the animal could not
have been dead for too long. Large sections of flesh have been torn from its
body and congealed blood has mixed with dirt to form a sticky mass on the
floor. You decide to move on and can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you make your way northward you become even more suspicious that there
is a reason no one walks this route. You are unsure why because the path to
the east is covered by large tree roots beyond which you cannot see. However,
they look flexible enough so you might be able to squeeze through if you
wanted. Otherwise, you will have to journey back to the south.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Pit
rooms.desc:
No sooner have you made your way through the wall of roots than you stumble
and fall down a rather deep pit. Cursing silently you realize there is no easy
way out of here and climbing up the dirt wall would surely result in half of
it collapsing down upon you. The bones of others as fortunate as yourself rest
on the ground but you can find nothing that would aid in your escape.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
For some reason this area of the burrows has been frequented regularly 
judging by the number of footprints on the ground. However, what strikes you
as odd is that they only travel north and south along the tunnel, not to the
west. Tree roots to the west make it difficult to pass but you could certainly
squeeze through with some effort.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the east or to
the north. As you ponder which way to go, the earthen walls begin to shake and
a cloud of dirt fills the air. There is a rumbling noise which grows louder
and louder by the minute before it passes over the top of you and is gone
as suddenly as it came. You have no idea what is was and decide that it might
be more prudent to move on unless the roof itself caves in upon you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You pass by the unfortunate corpse of a fellow adventurer. It's still in
one piece so you can only assume it wasn't eaten by the inhabitants of this
place. Whatever remained of the poor soul's possessions have been taken and
he now rests here in eternal sleep. Stepping over the corpse, you can go to
the west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Well...you are now stuck. You are wedged firmly between the walls and no
matter how hard you struggle, you can't pull yourself through. While you sit
and ponder what to do, you hear what sounds like escaping air. You realize that
by sticking yourself in the tunnel, you've created a pressure differential
which thankfully pushes you out. Of course, you strike your head on a tree
root in the process but you are now free to continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You work your way through the narrow tunnel hoping beyond all hope that it
actually leads somewhere. To the east, it opens out into a larger tunnel where
you can again stand or you may crawl northward into the darkness.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel twists and turns for several hundred feet before arriving at
this T-junction. There is a small opening in the western wall which you could
probably crawl through or you may progress to the north or south if you wish
to remain upright.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice about this tunnel is that it doesn't appear to
have ever been used. Of course, something had to create it but over time, any
footprints on the ground have been covered by the endless amount of dirt down
here. You can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You make your way slowly as you are now on your hands and knees. The earth
closes in around you and it's a tight squeeze to move yourself through. The
tunnel continues to the south and also to the east where it opens up.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The odor grows stronger to the west and you can just hear the faint sounds
of metal moving against metal. The tunnel in that directions also grows rather
small so it will be necessary to crawl through it should you wish to travel
that way. Alternatively, the tunnels to the north and east are more open.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You detect a faint odor from the west and it's not overly pleasant. Noises
from the east also grab your attention and you must now decide which is the
safest of the two options.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You realize that you had better pay attention to where you walk as you get
your foot snagged on another of those annoying roots. Thankfully, you do not
injure yourself and may continue to the north, west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You crawl further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of
dirt. Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has
not been completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work
your way through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface.
The tunnel to the east will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel slopes uphill gently before leveling off, thus making it an
even tighter squeeze than it was before. Fortunately, the tunnel ends further
to the west or you can return to the T-junction to the east to escape the
narrow crawlspace.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls still make it difficult to squeeze more than one person
through at a time. The tunnel now splits and you can travel to the west,
north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the south or
east. You are finding it difficult to breathe with the combination of the heat
within these tunnels and the cloud of dirt that you kick up as you move.
Nothing seems more appealing right now than cool, fresh air and perhaps a swim
in the river to clean yourself.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you work your way through the burrows, you notice that the roof is
sometimes nothing more than a thin layer of dirt covered by grass on the
surface above. It's a wonder that nothing walking above you comes crashing
down but whatever constructed these tunnels has obviously done the bare
minimum of work to ensure that won't happen. You have a choice of exits; north
west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You could swear that there are a number of eyes staring at you but the more
you try and peer into the darkness, the less you are able to see. You stand
silently for a moment and hear nothing but your own breathing. You may push on
to the west, south or north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have difficulty navigating the bend in this narrow tunnel. You almost
get stuck but have just enough room to continue to the north or to the east.
The odor is getting close to unbearable and is definitely coming from the
east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You find yourself crawling through a small layer of what appears to be
blood! It's fairly fresh too considering the warmth and ease at which it
ripples as you place you hands and knees in it. The tunnel bends again and
continues to the west and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You peer around the corner in the tunnel and are dismayed to find even more
dirt. Face it, you're not getting out of here in a hurry. The roof is also
quite low here which means you have to stoop to get by. It looks very similar
to the south while to the east you may be able to stand upright.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have a choice of four directions here, the only difference being that
to the west the tunnel roof slopes downward so it may be difficult to travel
through. You notice another bundle of tree roots to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The roots here surround three sides of the tunnels end and would allow
you to easily climb them if you wish. The tunnel roof might take some work to
get through but if you wish to leave this place, it's definitely an option.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have to push your way through the tunnel walls to progress any further
and as a result are now covered in dirt. You would have thought that the tunnel
would now be wider but it looks the same as it did before. A large tree root
passes from the west to east through the wall and you have to crouch down to
get by it. The tunnel extends to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have actually found the first signs of life within the earthen walls of
this place! They may only be worms, but they are indeed a sign that something
happens here. You may continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You must be careful to avoid the tree roots which protrude through the
tunnel roof. and disappear into the dirt floor upon which you stand. Numerous
footsteps can be seen on the ground, some of them yours, the majority belonging
to something else. The tunnel bends here and you can travel to the east or to
the south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel has simply been carved out of the earth as is evident by the
claw marks on the tunnel walls. A small amount of light comes from an opening
to the south allowing you to see without the aid of a torch or magic. Tunnels
to the north and west stretch into the darkness.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have found the source of the odor and it's through a large hole in the
tunnel floor. The fresh blood drips down into it and you can hear it collecting
at the bottom which doesn't sound that far away. Tree roots will allow easy
access to the lower level if you wish to go down there.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You now have trouble staying in one spot as the tunnel slopes downward to
the south and the layer of blood is making traction difficult. Fortunately,
the number of tree roots is growing larger and you are able to steady yourself
as you travel. The tunnel extends to the north and west.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You are forced to stoop as you make your way through the tunnel, the roof
dipping quite significantly compared to other areas you have progressed
through. To the south, the tunnel opens into a larger chamber while it doesn't
appear to be much better to the north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You actually have found the first signs of life within the earthen walls
of this place! They may only be worms, but they are indeed a sign that
something happens here. You can continue to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You find it surprising that whoever built these tunnels was not uniform
about it. While the place you stand is the same as the tunnel to the east and
south, the tunnel to the north is noticeably smaller and would slow you down
immensely if you wanted to travel through it.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You just miss falling into a small ditch in the middle of the tunnel. It is
perfectly shaped as though a giant ball had been placed there at one time.
Fortunately, you are not hurt and can continue to the west, north or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Clumps of dirt fall from the roof and walls as you walk through the burrows.
Despite the roots that appear to extend in all directions, the tunnels lack
the moisture necessary to hold this area together. You must be careful as you
journey to avoid being buried alive. A small source of light can just be seen
to the east while tunnels continue to the north, west and south.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Light filters through a maze of tree roots above you and illuminates a
small room carved out of the earth. Tunnels spear off in all directions
although you can't see more than a few feet into them. Unknown sounds
occasionally break the silence around you and a shiver runs down your spine
either in anticipation or fear.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Dirt, dirt and even more dirt. Not surprising since the tunnel has been
created beneath the surface of the forest but you're already covered in the
stuff and it's not pleasant. You duck just in time to miss one of the many
tree roots that criss-cross the roof and walls and wonder how far this
tunnel system could possibly extend. You can barely make out a small room to
the west while the tunnel extends to the south and east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
It must have taken years to build this underground network, especially
since it looks like it was done by hand...or perhaps you could say claw. The
scratch marks in the walls are very obvious and although the earthen walls
crumble easily under your touch, it must have taken a lot of work to dig
through and then remove the tons of dirt. Your only options here are to
travel to the west or east.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You step into the northwestern corner of what appears to be a sleeping 
chamber within the burrows. The only difference between this area and the
tunnels you have traveled through is the size, dirt is still everywhere and
the oppressive heat from lack of air flow is starting to wear you down. Simple
mats of branches and leaves are scattered haphazardly around the cave and you
can easily hear the loud slumber of something but you cannot see into the
darkness. The cave continues to the east and south or you may enter one of
the tunnels to the north or west.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
This corner of the chamber is noticeably smaller than the others and funnels
into a tunnel that leads to the north. You trip on something and land face
first into the dirt floor, narrowly missing one of the branches laid out here.
Looking back, a collection of six animal bones has been painstakingly buried
into the ground in the shape of a circle for reasons unknown. Ponder as you
might, you cannot find a reason and decide to continue.

rooms.name: At the Bottom of a Pit
rooms.desc:
No sooner have you made your way through the wall of roots than you stumble
and fall down a rather deep pit. Cursing silently you realize there is no easy
way out of here and climbing up the dirt wall would surely result in half of it
collapsing down upon you. The bones of others as fortunate as yourself rest on
the ground but you can find nothing that would aid in your escape.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Once again you are forced to weave your way through a number of tree roots
that pierce the surface and continue downward through the dirt floor. With a
little effort, you could push your way westward or travel to the north and east
where the roots aren't as thick as they are here.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the west or to
the south. As you ponder which way to go, the earthen walls begin to shake
and a cloud of dirt fills the air. There is a rumbling noise which grows louder
and louder by the minute before it passes over the to of you and is gone as
suddenly as it came. You have no idea what it was and decide that it might
be more prudent to move on unless the roof itself caves in upon you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A sense of foreboding descends upon you as you walk by what appears to be
the carcass of a small animal. It has been here for some time judging by the
distinct lack of flesh and the layer of dirt covering it but why it is here
remains a mystery. The tunnel extends to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel gently slopes downhill to the south and the roof of grass and
roots is slowly replaced by a layer of dirt. A recess to the west appears to
have been the beginning of another tunnel but it never progressed more than a
few feet. The entrance to the burrows lies just to the north while the tunnel
continues to the east and south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand at a crossroads within the tunnel system. The only difference
between any of the exits is that the one to the south looks slightly narrower
than the other three. Even with your light source, you cannot see much further
than a few feet in front of you as clouds of dust and dirt float around you.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
This T-junction allows you to access tunnels to the west and south while
it enters a slightly larger chamber to the east. You can hear sounds of some
description coming from the chamber but apart from that, no others factors
can help with your decision on which way to go.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You find yourself in the southwestern corner of a small cave which is in
fact merely an extension of the tunnel system you have made your way through.
It's simply connected to three other rooms and has had the centre area removed
to increase its size. Judging by the collection of branches and leaves, you
believe the area is used as a sleeping chamber by the tunnel occupants which is
somewhat disconcerting since it means they are probably still here. The cave
continues to the north and east while a single tunnel departs to the west.

rooms.name: An Open Cave
rooms.desc:
You weave your way through the makeshift beds to another corner of this
sleeping chamber. The only difference between this area and the tunnels
through which you arrived is the size. A fair amount of work has gone into its
construction to provide a suitable area to accommodate a large number of
creatures, whoever they may be. The cave opens up to the north an west while
a tunnel leaves to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You blink as shafts of light beam through small holes in the roof. You fear
that anything walking on the surface above you would more than likely come
through the weakened roof and land on you so perhaps it is prudent to move
into the tunnel to the west or south. You could also try and climb out onto
the surface.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A section of the earthen wall has collapsed making it difficult to proceed
in any direction but you have the choice of north, east or south. The heat
within the tunnels is almost unbearable as there is virtually no air flow.
You can imagine this place during the heat of the day as being similar to
walking through a wall of fire and are thankful at least that the darkness
keeps the temperature down a little.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
A T-junction in the tunnel system allows you to travel to the north, west
or east. Thoughts of leaving a trail enter your mind as you progress deeper
into the maze as every part of this area looks exactly the same. Looking down,
you see a series of footprints and wonder if any of them are actually yours.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel walls narrow here and are just wide enough to allow one person to
pass through. You trip and fall on an exposed root and curse at your misfortune
as you get a face full of dirt. Coughing and spitting, you have the choice to
travel north, west or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have to push your way through the tunnel walls to progress any further
and as a result you are now covered in dirt. You would have thought that the
tunnel would now be wider but it looks the same as it did before. A large tree
root passes from the west to east through the wall and you have to crouch down
to get by. The tunnel extends to the north and to the south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The first thing you notice is the smell, then you see the cause. Off to the
side of the tunnel is the rotting carcass of what must have been a deer. You
are almost overwhelmed by the stench but notice that the animal could not
have been dead for too long. Large sections of flesh have been torn from its
body and congealed blood has mixed with dirt to form a sticky mess on the
floor. You decide to move on and can travel to the north or south.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel turns abruptly here and allows you to travel to the south or
east. You are finding it difficult to breathe with the combination of the heat
within these tunnels and the cloud of dirt that you kick up as you move.
Nothing seems more appealing right now than cool, fresh air and perhaps a swim
in the river to clean yourself.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Clumps of grass have begun to grow on the floor in front of you indicating
that perhaps the tunnels in this part of the burrows have been here for quite
some time. You are amazed that the grass can grow without the aid of sunlight
and water but then again, you don't know what lies beneath your feet if in fact
the burrows extend that far. You can travel to the west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls slowly give way to solid rock to the east which is why the
tunnel continues to the west and north. There is evidence that whoever
constructed these tunnels did try to dig through the rock but it was obviously
unsuccessful.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You walk further down the tunnel and come face to face with a wall of dirt.
Whether it was intentional or not, work on this area of the tunnel has not been
completed. You could be mistaken, but it looks like you could work your way
through the scant covering of grass above you and onto the surface. The tunnel
to the east will take you back into the burrows.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
As you work your way through the burrows, you notice that the roof is
sometimes nothing more than a thin layer of dirt covered by grass on the
surface above. It's a wonder that nothing walking above you comes crashing
down but whatever constructed these tunnels has obviously done the bare
minimum of work to ensure that won't happen. You have a choice of exits;
north, west or east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You almost get wedged between the narrowing tunnel walls but just scrape
through. Something similar to a snicker catches your attention but before you
can register a direction, it is gone. The tunnel opens up to the west and
continues deeper into the darkness to the east.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The earthen walls still make it difficult to squeeze more than one person
through at a time but it looks as if the tunnel opens up to the south where you
can also hear the sound of running water. Alternatively, you could try and make
your way to the west or north.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The effort to reach the tunnels end seems hardly worth it. Whoever built
the tunnels has decided that this section should travel no further and you now
stare blankly at a wall of dirt, claw marks still visible on the southern end
of the tunnel. Bones cover the floor although you cannot determine the original
owner or why they sit in this place.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel bends here and continues to the north and east. The roots that
have been quite prolific elsewhere are noticeably absent from the roof of
this section. You notice that its nothing more than a thin layer of dirt
covered by grass on the surface above. With a little effort, you might be
able to force your way through the roof and back into the forest.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Footsteps on the dirt floor lead to the north and west from here, the only
exits from this part of the tunnel system. You are almost speared by one of the
numerous tree roots while you stare at the ground but manage to pull yourself
back in time. An ear piercing shriek startles you but it is the only sound made
and you are uncertain as to which direction it came from.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
The tunnel ends almost as soon as it started...it is nothing more than a
small recess off the cavern to the south. The walls here are almost purely
constructed from tree roots which provide hand and foot holds through the
hole in the ground. Silence is the only thin to greet you from the hole and
its murky darkness provides no clue as to what lies below.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The edge of the river is relatively small and you have to be careful not
to sink too deeply into the mud that has been created. Dirt walls prevent
further travel to the west or north but you can travel along the shoreline to
the east. The river to your south simply appears from an opening in the wall
and flows steadily to the east.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground River
rooms.desc:
If you had been wondering where the many trees of Noirwood got their
nutrients then the river before you is the most likely of answers. You stand
on the edge of an underground river that flows to the east and into a small
tunnel that you cannot clearly see down. The shoreline extends to the west
and abruptly ends while the tunnel network of the burrows lies to the north
through a narrow opening.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
The shoreline extends to the east and abruptly ends while a narrow tunnel
leads off to the north. The calmer waters of this underground lake lie directly
to the south but you would have to fight the river current if you intended to
leave this place.

rooms.name: The Edge of an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
Unless you plan to return to the water, your only option here is to walk
along the shoreline to the west. Although there is no natural source of light
within the cavern, the obvious exit appears to be back along the river you
traveled although you can make out the entrance to a tunnel at the western end
of the shore.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river flows through a narrow opening in the western wall but it is too
small for you to fit into. A steady current travels to the east where in the
distance you can see the river disappears into the eastern wall. A small
shoreline lies to the north.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river pulls you towards the east as it rushes into a narrow tunnel in
the wall. You could fight the steady current and travel to the west or
alternatively, you could struggle onto the shoreline to the north.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground River
rooms.desc:
The river continues its travel to the east although you can try and move
upstream to the west if you wish. The sound of the river reverberates off the
hollowed tunnel and is almost deafening at times. You can see what looks like a
small lake to the east where your journey will undoubtably end.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
The river pours out into a larger chamber and the current dies almost
instantly allowing you free travel around this underground lake. The lake
itself is not overly large, the southern side terminates at a wall of mud
and dirt while to the north you can see another shoreline.

rooms.name: Floating on an Underground Lake
rooms.desc:
This is the furthest point on the underground lake that you can travel. To
your south and east you are prevented from moving further by the cavern wall
but you can continue back to the west or onto the shore to the north.

rooms.name: At the Base of a Large Hole
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the bottom of a large hole in the roof, ankle deep in
a pool of blood. This thought doesn't overly worry you since you've had to
slay many creatures to reach here, but the fact that the blood is still warm
does concern you. Just above your head sit a number of tree roots which you
could use to climb back to the level above or you could enter a medium sized
chamber to the south.

rooms.name: An Orc Storeroom
rooms.desc:
The two rooms here, the other to the south, are obviously used to store
the bounty the orcs obtain when they go on their village raids. You can see
a variety of weapons and armor pieces, chests of treasure and a number of
useless trinkets which must have caught their eye. Most of the items here
are damaged beyond repair but something may be of value if you scrounge
around a bit.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You have stumbled across the heart of the orc burrows for it is here that
the numerous raids these creatures carry out are planned. The rotting corpses
of many unfortunate creatures litter the floor and the stench of death is
very overpowering. Screams of agony echo around you and you realize not all
within this chamber is dead. Eyes glow in the surrounding darkness and all
seem to be focused on you.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You skirt around a makeshift table in the centre of the room and have the
choice of moving to the west or south. You trip over a collection of bones
in the corner and land head first into the carcass of a small forest animal.
The signs of decay are abundant as you look around after having wiped yourself
off and you pity the victims of the Dharzi orcs who will eventually wind up
here.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You step on the arm of what looks like a dwarven warrior and he yelps in
pain and surprise. He has a number of tear marks and his flesh almost hangs
from his body. The Dharzi orcs have claimed another victim who will shortly
join his companions in the spiritual plane. You may leave him and travel to
the north or east.

rooms.name: The Center of the Burrows
rooms.desc:
Blood pooling on the floor is now rising at an alarming level given the
size of this chamber. You are now up to your ankles in the stuff which doesn't
seem to be disappearing quickly. Body parts from numerous creatures have been
hung from the chamber roof in the twisted maze of roots that cover it. You
decide it might be more prudent to continue moving to the north or west.

rooms.name: An Orc Storeroom
rooms.desc:
The two rooms here, the other to the north, are obviously used to store
the bounty the orcs obtain when they go on their village raids. You can see
a variety of weapons and armor pieces, chests of treasure and a number of
useless trinkets which must have caught their eye. Most of the items here
are damaged beyond repair but something may be of value if you scrounge
around a bit.

rooms.name: A Tunnel Within the Burrows
rooms.desc:
You stand outside some type of store room, only apparent by the large amount
of goods you can see through the molded doorway in the western wall. You may
enter if you wish or journey back down the tunnel to the south.

rooms.name: At the Base of a Large Hole
rooms.desc:
There is no real difference between the tunnel you now find yourself in and
those you have passed through to get here. At least the proximity to the river
has provided some moisture to the earthen walls and they now look slightly more
robust that others within the burrow. The tunnel leads on to the north or you
can return to the upper level through the hole in the roof.
